facts.fact: The National Digital and Future Skills Strategy, gazetted on 23 September 2020, says government has set up provincial CoLabs at historically disadvantaged universities and that tech hubs and digital incubators function as spaces for innovation learning, and commits to introduce funding and support for CoLabs, digital tech hubs and incubators, with no programme or cohort stated.
